translations.web: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
translations.bsb: All the nations are as nothing before Him; He regards them as nothingness and emptiness.
translations.kjv: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
translations.asv: All the nations are as nothing before him; they are accounted by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
